title: TIL: You can make HTTP requests without curl using Bash /dev/TCP
summary: A practical tutorial demonstrating how to use bash's built-in /dev/tcp feature to establish TCP connections and make raw HTTP requests without relying on external tools like curl or wget.
problem_solved: Enables making HTTP requests in minimal environments where curl/wget aren't available, and teaches underlying network communication principles.
why_valuable: Provides a dependency-free way to understand HTTP at the protocol level and serves as a fallback for system administrators working in constrained environments.
